Order 
This is first bail application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagrik Surksha Sanhita.

2. The applicant is in custody since 10.02.2025 in connection with Crime No.875/2024 registered at P.S.-Kotwali Betul, District-Betul (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 384 and 420 of IPC.

3. Prosecution story, in brief, is that complainant Durgesh was running a shop in the name of Kanishka Interior and complainant credited Rs. 4,78,000/- in applicant's account for purchase of interior accessories but applicant did not supply the aforesaid accessories to complainant.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that it is a case of civil nature.
Only allegation against the present applicant is that he received Rs. 4,78,000/- from the complainant but he did not supply the interior accessories to the complainant.
Applicant is in jail since 10.02.2025.
Applicant is ready to refund said money to the complainant.
It is urged that no purpose would be served by keeping the applicant behind the bar.

The trial of the case will take considerable NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:12188 2 MCRC-11161-2025 time.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant be released on bail pending the trial.

sentences.text: On the other hand, learned Panel Lawyer has opposed the grant of bail to the applicant 6.
Looking to overall facts and circumstances of the case, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, first bail application filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant be released on bail subject to depositing of sum Rs.4,78,000/- before the trial Court and on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court,
for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
8. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
9. Soft copy of this bail order immediately/forthwith be sent to applicant through concerned Jail Superintendent.
10. Certified copy as per rules.

(ACHAL KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE L.R.
